description: Replay verified publication events against measured 1, 5 and 20-observation FX reference returns. Daily windows exclude the publication-day fixing; changes from previous actuals are not consensus surprises. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: FX base currency for market context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

currency.description: Currency for macro event series, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

indicator.description: Indicator slug for event replay. Supported examples: catalogue indicator slug, e.g. inflation or policy_rate.

lookback_events.description: Maximum number of recent events to include in replay.

quote.description: FX quote currency for market context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

name: event_impact_replay_task
title: Event Impact Replay
